# Welcome to My Github hosted material.

I have started this so I can share my experiences of working on projects.
Specifically, I am working on a project with [FirstPrinciples](https://firstpriciples.com/) to assess how their AI tools can help quantum physics researchers,
with a particular focus on those using QuTiP.

I am a maintainer of the [QuTiP](https://qutip.org/) (Quantum Toolbox in Python) project.

I do some other things as well, but for now I'll just be posting about Theo Meets QuTiP.

## About This Site

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and hosted on GitHub Pages.
